Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who We Are
 We are looking for an experienced software engineer to join a research and innovation team exploring the application of Physical AI, autonomous systems and connected drones.
The role will focus on developing and proving new capabilities that connect autonomous or remotely operated physical devices with cloud, edge and enterprise platforms. Initial research use cases include crowd monitoring and public safety, emergency-service applications, and autonomous parcel delivery, with scope to explore additional applications as the technology develops.
This is primarily a backend and integration-focused engineering role, although the target environment includes Android-based devices and applications. The successful candidate will therefore bring strong experience of Android development, Kotlin and modern API/service development, ideally including Ktor.
You will work in a research environment where requirements will evolve rapidly and where experimentation, prototyping and technical problem solving are as important as production software engineering.
 What You'll Be Doing
Design and develop software supporting Physical AI and autonomous-system research use cases
Build backend services and device-side components using Kotlin, with Ktor highly desirable
Develop and integrate Android-based applications and services supporting connected devices, drones and edge-computing platforms
Design and implement RESTful APIs, WebSockets and event-driven interfaces between devices, edge platforms and cloud services
Integrate with drone platforms, SDKs, telemetry services, sensors, cameras and other physical devices
Develop capabilities for real-time ingestion and processing of telemetry, location, sensor, image and video metadata
Support command-and-control interactions between applications and autonomous or remotely operated devices
Prototype new use cases quickly, taking concepts from initial experimentation through to working demonstrators and proofs of concept
Investigate the use of AI/ML and computer vision services within physical and autonomous-system workflows
Design solutions capable of operating across device, edge and cloud environments, including scenarios with intermittent or constrained connectivity
Implement appropriate authentication, authorisation, encryption and secure communications between devices and services
Develop automated unit, integration and API testing and contribute to CI/CD pipelines
Diagnose complex problems spanning applications, networks, devices and cloud infrastructure
Produce clear technical documentation covering architecture, APIs, experiments and research findings
Collaborate with researchers, software engineers, network specialists, AI specialists and external technology partners
 What You'll Bring Along
BSc/MSc in Computer Science or related field
Minimum 6+ years as an Android Developer
Kotlin development is a must
Android application and service development, including Android SDK and Android lifecycle concepts
Backend development using Kotlin; experience with Ktor would be particularly valuable
Design and implementation of REST APIs and asynchronous/event-driven services
HTTP, WebSockets and common messaging patterns
Concurrent and asynchronous programming using Kotlin Coroutines
JSON and common data serialisation approaches
Integration with third-party SDKs and APIs
Git and modern source-control practices
Automated testing, including unit and integration testing
CI/CD and contemporary DevOps practices
Containerisation using Docker
Experience deploying applications or services to a major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud
Strong troubleshooting skills across distributed applications and services
Desirable Skills:
Drone/UAV development, including integration with drone SDKs, flight controllers or ground-control systems
MAVLink, PX4, ArduPilot, DJI SDKs or similar drone/autonomous-system technologies
Edge computing and edge AI
Computer vision and video analytics
Integration with AI/ML inference services
Real-time video streaming technologies such as WebRTC or RTSP
MQTT, Kafka or other event/messaging technologies
GPS/GNSS, geospatial data and mapping technologies
IoT device integration and telemetry
4G/5G connectivity and mobile-network concepts
Linux and embedded/edge computing environments
Kubernetes or container orchestration
Observability technologies including logging, metrics, tracing and distributed monitoring
PostgreSQL, NoSQL or time-series databases
Python, particularly for AI/ML integration, prototyping or data processing
Security, Safety & Responsible AI
Because the research involves physical devices, cameras, location information and potentially public-safety applications, the successful candidate should understand the importance of building security, privacy, safety and responsible AI principles into solutions from the outset
